notes: Flutter Dart-AOT release, Linux GTK embedder. frame_ms = interval between consecutive FrameTiming rasterFinish timestamps (engine raster thread finished the frame, frame handed to the GTK/GL presenter; NOT a guaranteed screen-update timestamp; no visibility into X11 present). Only frames the engine actually rasterized are reported (a frame with no dirty layer is never produced, so no empty frames are counted); continuous redraw by a Ticker that dirties the scene every tick. Frames filtered to rasterFinish within the measured window [start,end] after a 2 s warm-up; timings are batched by the engine so 800 ms extra were waited. Engine switches env: default-backend. managed_heap_kb is null: the Dart VM service/heap stats are not available in product AOT release; rss_kb (ProcessInfo.currentRss, whole process) is given instead. list = ListView.builder with real per-row heights (itemExtent/prototypeItem not applicable to variable heights); scroll set by ScrollController.jumpTo in a Ticker callback from the closed-form script; during warm-up the script time is frozen at 0.
